title: INSPIRE: Accelerating Deep Neural Networks via Hardware-friendly Index-Pair Encoding
problem: Variable-length quantization for DNNs introduces significant hardware overhead in encoding/decoding, and existing quantization methods are less effective for both activations and weights due to the presence of outliers.
motivation: DNN inference consumes significant computing resources and memory, necessitating efficient acceleration techniques.
method: INSPIRE proposes index-pair encoding, a hardware-friendly scheme for variable-length quantization that assigns high precision to outlier values and low precision to normal values. The method minimizes encoding/decoding overhead while handling both activations and weights effectively.
key_novelty: Hardware-friendly index-pair encoding mechanism that enables efficient variable-length quantization without excessive encoding/decoding overhead.
contributions: Index-pair encoding scheme for variable-length quantization with reduced hardware overhead
Unified quantization approach for both activations and weights
Hardware-optimized implementation for accelerated DNN inference
Improved handling of outlier values in neural networks
limitations: Limitations not discussed in the abstract.
